coherence_issues.description: S8 states that natural gas purchases fell by 68% to EUR 1.477 million, mainly because balancing-gas costs decreased by 99%. However, S5 states that revenue from system balancing products fell by 99% due to a new transit agreement. There is no explicit logical link explaining how the decrease in balancing-gas costs (a cost item) directly results from the reduction in revenue from system balancing products (a revenue item). The relationship between these two changes is implied but not explained, creating a small logical gap.
